title: continuous-batcher: scheduler tuning for queueing fairness, starvation prevention, timeouts
author: Priya Desai
release_notes: Tuned continuous batcher scheduler to improve queueing fairness and prevent request starvation. Added configurable per-queue timeouts, improved dequeue ordering heuristics, new metrics and traces. No public API changes. Rollout via feature flag; gradual canary followed by cluster-wide enable.
description: Summary: This PR tunes the continuous-batcher scheduler to reduce starvation and improve fairness across heterogeneous request classes while bounding maximum queueing latency via timeouts. Motivation: Production traces and perf canaries showed long-tail starvation for low-priority / long-sequence requests when mixed with high-throughput short requests; this caused customer-visible latency spikes and degraded quality for certain SLAs. Design: Introduce per-queue aging and dynamic priority bumping, add configurable starvation_timeout and queue_timeout knobs, switch from strict FIFO per-slot to a hybrid weighted-dequeue that respects batch fill targets and fairness windows, and add metrics/traces for queue wait time distributions. Implementation: Changes live in runtime/continuous_batcher/* and runtime/scheduler/*; key additions are QueueController, aging heuristics, timeout enforcement, and a lightweight eviction path that re-injects timed-out requests into the fallback routing layer. Also added unit tests, integration tests that run with synthetic traffic profiles, and perf harness updates. Backwards compatibility: No public API or RPC changes; behavior behind feature flag continuous_batcher_scheduler_v2. Impact: In perf canary runs we observed 4-7% improvement in median throughput for mixed workloads and reduction in 95th/99th queue-wait latency by 30-45% depending on profile. There is a modest CPU cost due to extra bookkeeping which is under the alerting threshold and acceptable for dedicated and hosted services. Testing: Added new test vectors for starvation scenarios, expanded perf harness to feed mixed short/long sequences, and ran end-to-end staging canary for 72 hours. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout, 10% nodes for 24h, 30% for 48h, then full enable if no regressions. Monitoring/alerts: New metrics continuous_batcher.queue_wait_p50/p95/p99, continuous_batcher.starvation_events, and an internal alert when starvation_events > threshold. Related: builds on prior scheduling work (ENG-3197) and KV-cache improvements in ENG-3361. Checklist: unit tests added, integration tests passing, perf benchmarks added, docs updated (internal ops runbook), feature flag gating in place.
